questions.stem: 因羨慕網路上別人的完美生活，許多年輕人不再確定自己是否快樂。
questions.answer: Because they envy the perfect lives of others online, many young people are no longer sure whether they are happy.
accepted_answers: Envying other people's perfect lives online, many young people no longer know if they are happy.
Since they are jealous of the perfect lives others show online, many young people no longer feel sure whether they are happy.

patterns: 間接問句（whether 名詞子句）

questions.stem: 因此，他們不但要學習如何建立自信，也該減少使用社群媒體的時間。
questions.answer: Therefore, they should not only learn how to build confidence but also reduce the time they spend on social media.
accepted_answers: Therefore, they should not only learn how to be more confident but also spend less time on social media.
As a result, they should not only learn how to build their self-confidence but also cut down on their time on social media.

patterns: 不但…而且…（not only … but also）

1.explanation_zh: 「因羨慕…」中文省略主詞，英文要寫成 Because they envy …（或分詞構句 Envying …）；envy 是動詞，「羨慕的」形容詞要用 jealous／envious。「網路上別人的完美生活」改成後位修飾：the perfect lives of others online。「不再」用 no longer（放在 be 動詞後或一般動詞前）。「是否快樂」是間接問句，用 whether／if＋主詞＋動詞：whether they are happy。
evidence: 因羨慕網路上別人的完美生活
不再確定自己是否快樂
1.strategy_zh: 「是否」→ whether／if 間接問句，語序是主詞在前、動詞在後；「不再」→ no longer，不要寫成 not … again。
hints: 切成四段：因羨慕／網路上別人的完美生活／許多年輕人不再／確定自己是否快樂
標的詞彙：envy（羨慕）、perfect（完美的）、online（在網路上）、sure（確定的）、happy（快樂的）
句型框架：Because + S + V …, S + be + no longer sure + whether + S + V

2.explanation_zh: 「不但…也…」用 not only … but also，兩邊接同形式的原形動詞：should not only learn … but also reduce …。「如何建立自信」用疑問詞＋不定詞 how to build confidence（confidence 是名詞）。「使用社群媒體的時間」是前置修飾，改成 the time they spend on social media。
evidence: 不但要學習如何建立自信
也該減少使用社群媒體的時間
2.strategy_zh: not only … but also 前後要對稱：先找出中文「不但」「也」後面各是什麼詞性，再用同樣的形式翻譯。
hints: 切成四段：因此，他們不但要／學習如何建立自信／也該減少／使用社群媒體的時間
標的詞彙：learn（學習）、confidence（自信）、reduce（減少）、social media（社群媒體）、time（時間）
句型框架：S + should not only + VR1 + how to VR … but also + VR2 …

references: Because they envy the perfect lives of others online, many young people are no longer sure whether they are happy.
Envying other people's perfect lives online, many young people no longer know if they are happy.
Since they are jealous of the perfect lives others show online, many young people no longer feel sure whether they are happy.

patterns.label_zh: 間接問句（whether 名詞子句）
patterns.frame: S + be sure / know + whether / if + S + V（直述句語序）
S + no longer + V ／ S + be + no longer + adj.

common_errors.explanation_zh: envy 是動詞（或名詞），不能放在 be 動詞後當形容詞；形容詞要用 jealous／envious。
because 引導子句，要補上主詞 they（中文省略了）。

parts.zh: 網路上別人的完美生活
accepted: the perfect lives of others online
the perfect lives others show online
others' perfect lives on the Internet
the perfect lives of other people online
other people's perfect lives on social media

common_errors.right: the perfect lives of others online
common_errors.explanation_zh: 地點修飾語 online 放在名詞後面；「別人的生活」是很多人的生活，用複數 lives。

accepted: many young people are no longer
a lot of young people are no longer
lots of young people are no longer
many young people now no longer

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「不再」是 no longer 或 not … anymore，不是 not … again（不會再一次）。

common_errors.wrong: many young people are no longer to be sure
common_errors.right: many young people are no longer sure
common_errors.explanation_zh: no longer 放在 be 動詞後面，直接接形容詞 sure。

accepted: feel sure whether they are happy

common_errors.explanation_zh: 間接問句用直述句語序：whether＋主詞＋動詞。

traps.literal_error: Because envy other people's perfect lives online, many young people …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文前半句省略主詞，英文 because 子句要補 they，或改成分詞 Envying …。

traps.zh: 網路上別人的完美生活
traps.explanation_zh: 「網路上」放在名詞前是中文語序，英文要放到後面：the perfect lives of others online。

1.restructuring_zh: 前半句「因羨慕…」中文沒有主詞，英文要補成 Because they envy …（或用分詞 Envying …）；「網路上別人的完美生活」要把地點修飾語移到名詞後面：the perfect lives of others online。

references: Therefore, they should not only learn how to build confidence but also reduce the time they spend on social media.
Therefore, they should not only learn how to be more confident but also spend less time on social media.
As a result, they should not only learn how to build their self-confidence but also cut down on their time on social media.

patterns.label_zh: 不但…而且…（not only … but also）
patterns.frame: S + should + not only + VR1 … but also + VR2 …（前後同詞性）

accepted: As a result, they should not only
Therefore, they need not only to

common_errors.wrong: Therefore, they should not only to learn
common_errors.right: Therefore, they should not only learn
common_errors.explanation_zh: should 後面接原形動詞，not only 不改變這個規則。

accepted: learn how to be more confident
learn how to build their self-confidence
learn how to build up their confidence
learn how to become more confident

common_errors.explanation_zh: build 後面接名詞 confidence；confident 是形容詞（be confident）。
疑問詞後面接不定詞：how to＋原形動詞。
not only … but also 連接的兩個動詞要同形式：learn … reduce …。
not only 要和 but (also) 搭配。

accepted: the time they spend on social media
the time spent on social media
the amount of time they spend on social media
how much time they spend on social media

common_errors.right: the time they spend on social media
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「使用社群媒體的時間」要把 time 放前面，修飾語放後面：the time (that) they spend on social media。

common_errors.wrong: the time they spend on social medias
common_errors.right: the time they spend on social media
common_errors.explanation_zh: media 本身就是複數形，不加 s。

traps.explanation_zh: 「自信」是名詞 confidence；confident 是形容詞，要用 be／become confident。
「使用社群媒體的時間」要改成後位修飾：the time they spend on social media。

bonus.text: Therefore, not only should they learn how to build confidence, but they should also reduce the time they spend on social media.
bonus.explanation_zh: Not only 放句首時，後面的子句要倒裝（should they learn）。這是加分寫法，一般的 not only … but also 就能拿滿分。

2.restructuring_zh: 「使用社群媒體的時間」是前置修飾，英文要改成 the time they spend on social media（time 後面接省略 that 的形容詞子句）；「不但…也…」要讓 not only 和 but also 後面接同樣形式的原形動詞。

1.translation: Envying other people's perfect lives on the Internet, many young people are no longer sure whether they are happy.
1.explanation_zh: 「因羨慕……」與主要子句同主詞，用分詞構句 Envying … 表原因（也可寫 Because they envy …）；「不再確定自己是否快樂」用 no longer sure whether 名詞子句；「網路上別人的完美生活」譯 other people's perfect lives on the Internet，lives 用複數。信心 medium 是因為原因部分可用分詞構句或 because 子句。

2.translation: Therefore, they should not only learn how to build self-confidence but also reduce the time they spend on social media.
2.explanation_zh: 「不但……也……」用 not only … but also，前後都接原形動詞保持對稱；「如何建立自信」用 how to build self-confidence；「減少使用社群媒體的時間」譯 reduce the time they spend on social media。

issues_zh: （小建議，不影響判定）R2 用 be jealous of，語氣偏「嫉妒」，比「羨慕」強；可接受，但 envy／be envious of 較貼切。
（小建議，不影響判定）標的句型代碼 NCL 對應的是 how to＋VR（gp-wh-to，疑問詞＋不定詞），嚴格說是名詞片語而不是名詞子句；不影響題目品質，但程式若用 NCL 粗略比對子句可能出 warning。

1.translation: Because they envy other people's perfect lives online, many young people are no longer sure whether they are happy.
1.explanation_zh: 「因羨慕…」改成 Because they envy 的副詞子句（也可用 Envious of ...）；「不再確定」是 are no longer sure；「是否」用 whether 引導名詞子句。

2.translation: Therefore, they should not only learn how to build self-confidence but also reduce the time they spend on social media.
2.explanation_zh: 「不但…也…」用 not only ... but also ... 且兩邊結構平行（learn / reduce）；「該」用 should；「減少使用社群媒體的時間」用 reduce the time they spend on social media，以關係子句修飾 time。
